svg.title: Four-tier asset health index
svg.desc: Station score, then asset-class scores for pumps, fans and mills, then individual equipment scores, then the named sensor tags each score is built from.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A health index has to be openable

svg.text: Four tiers, as deployed by Adani Power on AVEVA PI. The bottom tier is the reason the top tier is trusted.
